title: LiDAR Detection System
description: A LiDAR-based project exploring object detection and classification, with live scanning, point-cloud processing and system integration.

sections.text: The documented architecture connects a LiDAR sensor, Raspberry Pi, MQTT broker, data storage and a camera-based component.
